h1: Concrete, Paving & Site Work in the Poconos
subtitle: Headquartered in Tobyhanna, our crews have built retail, public, school, and residential projects across Monroe and Pike counties.
intro: Kobalt Construction is headquartered in Tobyhanna, in the heart of the Poconos, and much of our work is close to home: retail and distribution sites in Mt. Pocono and Stroudsburg, public spaces like Marshalls Falls Park in East Stroudsburg and Ann Street Park in Milford, a new residential subdivision, and community facilities like Bushkill Outreach.
These are the Poconos-area projects we've documented, with a summary of the work our crews did on each.
cta_heading: Planning a Project in the Poconos?
cta_text: Tell us about the site and we'll get back to you within one business day.
